Overview.Name: Panasa Swathi
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 eggs omelette/bhurji (onion & tomato) (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt) & 1 boiled egg
Option 3: Rice upma (from leftover rice) (light oil, curry leaves) & 1 boiled egg
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice & fish curry (simple, pressure-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice & paneer curry (simple, pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Curd rice (smaller portion) & fish fry (pan-fried, 1 small piece)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (onion & tomato & lemon & salt)
Option 2: Roasted makhana (hand-roasted in ghee) (salt & chilli powder)
Meal_3: Option 1: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & small bowl cooked rice
Option 2: Fish fry (pan-fried, 1 small piece) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Paneer soup (thin) (paneer 50 g) & buttermilk (unsweetened) (lightest option)

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals simple and repeatable (fixed routine): same meal timings daily to support energy and consistency.
Craving/over-control strategy: don’t start eating with snacks—start lunch with curd/buttermilk, then eat rice & fish/paneer slowly (10–15 mins).
Late-night trigger: aim dinner by 8:30–9:00 pm; if hungry later, use only bedtime drink or buttermilk.
Thyroid-friendly lunch routine: keep lunch protein-forward (fish/paneer/eggs) & ~1 cup cooked rice (~150 g) & curd/buttermilk for stable energy and better control.
Field-work busy day: carry a small box of murmura or roasted makhana & buttermilk to prevent impulse eating.
Non-veg preference: keep fish mainly at lunch (your preferred meal); keep dinner lighter on most days.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: prioritise protein-first meals and steady meal timing for better satiety and stable energy.
